name: Alex
summary: 34, support team lead. Lives in admin tools all day (Zendesk, Jira, Slack). Fast, confident, skims.
context: At your desk between two calls. You've done this sort of thing in a dozen tools and expect it to take thirty seconds.
temperament: Brisk and a little impatient with clunky software. Says what you think in a few words. Rarely blames yourself; blames the app.
